香港加强灭鼠行动有针对性 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港加强灭鼠行动 有针对性
香港食物环境卫生署报告灭鼠行动的进展，自11月4日起已巡查1,433个地点并捕获280只老鼠。该部门以老鼠洞穴为目标，并与其他机构合作消灭害虫。
2026 年 11 月 20 日 19:33 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 20 日 20:18 · 阅读时间 3 分钟
香港食物环境卫生署（食环署）公布代号为“雷霆行动”和“天网行动”的灭鼠行动取得进展。自11月4日开展“雷霆行动”以来，该署采取基于风险、有针对性的灭鼠方法，重点关注老鼠的洞穴和藏身之处，而不是仅仅将老鼠困在老鼠出现的地方。
截至11月19日，食环署已巡查全港1,433个地点，其中包括1,230个由其他政府部门管理的地点，例如公园及康乐区。在检查中，该部门共发现鼠洞或藏匿点282个，捕获活鼠161只，收缴死鼠119只。已完成 162 个地点的投毒和封闭洞穴工作。食环署表示，实际被杀死的老鼠数量可能更高，因为许多老鼠可能死在洞穴内而没有被发现。后续检查表明，治疗部位的大鼠活动显着减少。
在九龙城区，食环署以柴口里休憩处为目标，巡查人员发现该处有老鼠洞穴、花园围墙底部的缝隙，以及垃圾管理问题。该部门放置了毒饵并设置了陷阱，并组建了夜间流动小组进行害虫防治。抓获活鼠12只，处理鼠窝8个。食环署亦就乱扔垃圾发出两份定额罚款通知书及提出一项检控。该署建议康乐及文化事务署（康文署）进行设施维修工作，并加强清理食物残渣和堆积的杂物。
在元朗区凤翔路花园，食环署巡查员在两个花坛内发现七个活跃的老鼠洞穴，并发现食物残渣。该部门投放毒饵，收集死老鼠17只，摧毁鼠窝7个。康乐及文化事务署职员清理食物残渣及杂物，并安排将受影响的花坛移交。
食环署发言人表示，追踪和消灭鼠洞需要持续努力。他列举了早期重点关注尖沙咀文化中心的情况，自行动开始以来，该中心已捕获并收集了100多只老鼠。该部门继续监测洞穴和老鼠活动，调整策略并提醒现场管理人员保持清洁、防鼠和维修。
食环署亦已完成第三阶段的天网行动，为期两周的定向巡查及执法行动。在此阶段，该部门对商场和其他高风险地点的餐馆进行了1,996次检查，发出了62份消灭虫通知书、177份要求场所改善清洁和维护的通知、12份警告和提出115份检控。对于其他食品场所，共进行了 1,369 次检查，发出 24 份除害通知书、70 份改进通知、四份警告和 61 份起诉。 42家商场和大厦的物业经理获得奖励

Hong Kong steps up anti-rat campaigns with targeted operations
Hong Kong's Food and Environmental Hygiene Department reports progress in its anti-rat campaigns, having inspected 1,433 locations and captured 280 rats since 4 November. The department targets rat burrows and collaborates with other agencies to eliminate the pests.
20 Nov 2026 at 19:33 HKT · updated 20 Nov, 20:18 · 3 min read
Hong Kong's Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) has reported progress in its ongoing anti-rat campaigns, code-named "Thunder Operation" and "Sky Net Operation". Since the launch of Thunder Operation on 4 November, the department has adopted a risk-based, targeted approach to eliminate rats, focusing on their burrows and hiding places rather than merely trapping them in areas where they appear.
As of 19 November, FEHD had inspected 1,433 locations across the territory, including 1,230 sites managed by other government departments such as parks and recreational areas. During these inspections, the department discovered 282 rat burrows or hiding spots, captured 161 live rats, and collected 119 dead rats. Poisoning and sealing of burrows were completed at 162 locations. FEHD said the actual number of rats killed may be higher, as many may have died inside burrows and not been recovered. Follow-up checks indicated a significant reduction in rat activity at the treated sites.
In the Kowloon City district, FEHD targeted the Chai Hau Lane sitting-out area, where inspectors identified rat burrows, gaps at the base of garden walls, and rubbish management issues. The department laid poison baits and set traps, operating a mobile night team for pest control. Twelve live rats were caught, and eight rat nests were treated. FEHD also issued two fixed-penalty notices and initiated one prosecution for littering. The department advised the Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) to carry out facility repairs and improve cleaning of food scraps and accumulated debris.
In the Yuen Long district, at Fung Tseung Road Garden, FEHD inspectors found seven active rat burrows in two flowerbeds, along with food scraps. The department laid poison baits, collected 17 dead rats, and destroyed seven rat nests. LCSD staff cleared food scraps and debris and arranged for the affected flowerbeds to be turned over.
An FEHD spokesman said that tracing and eliminating rat burrows requires sustained effort. He cited the early-stage focus on the Tsim Sha Tsui Cultural Centre, where more than 100 rats have been captured and collected since the operation began. The department continues to monitor burrows and rat activity, adjusting its strategy and reminding site managers to maintain cleanliness, rodent-proofing, and repairs.
FEHD has also completed the third phase of its Sky Net Operation, a two-week targeted inspection and enforcement drive. During this phase, the department conducted 1,996 inspections of restaurants in shopping malls and other high-risk locations, issuing 62 pest elimination notices, 177 notices requiring premises to improve cleanliness and maintenance, 12 warnings, and filing 115 prosecutions. For other food premises, 1,369 inspections resulted in 24 pest elimination notices, 70 improvement notices, four warnings, and 61 prosecutions. Property managers of 42 malls and buildings received pest elimination notices. Inspectors required those responsible to optimise waste disposal, take effective rat-control measures, seal burrows, and eliminate hiding places.

content:
香港为劏房居民开设第10个社区客厅 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港为劏房居民开设第十个社区客厅
香港政务司司长于2026年11月20日出席北角第10个社区客厅的启用仪式。该设施由政府、太古地产及圣雅各福群会合作，为劏房居民提供服务，预计可容纳270户家庭
香港政务司司长于 2026 年 11 月 20 日星期五出席北角社区客厅的启用仪式，这是今年启用的第十个此类设施。这个占地 2,400 平方英尺的空间预计可容纳 270 个劏房家庭，每年提供 43,000 人次的访问。
社区客厅倡议是政府、企业和社区组织之间的合作。北角设施由圣雅各福群会负责营运，并得到太古地产及提供场地的太古集团慈善信托基金的支持。
布政司在仪式上致辞时表示，每个社区客厅都有自己的特色，并指出这间有很多孩子。他说，他已经与几位母亲交谈过，她们发现该设施很有帮助，因为它可以让她们在孩子玩耍时休息和社交。客厅设有儿童游乐区、厨房、缝纫活动和社区互动空间。
东区是港岛区劏房数量最多的地区。继 2025 年 3 月在筲箕开设类似设施后，新的北角客厅也开业，扩大了对该地区居民的支持。
圣雅各福群会还经营南昌社区客厅，自2000年起在东区提供家庭作业辅导、儿童发展服务、补贴申请和居民互助小组。该组织此前曾于2022年与太古地产和太古集团慈善信托基金合作，在鲗鱼涌创建一个名为“社区”的社区空间，用于举办工作坊和展览。
客厅的专业社工会主动接触劏房住户，识别高危家庭，并提供辅导和转介。该设施还提供工具、书籍和运动器材供居民共享。布政司表示，政府将继续充当推动者的角色，鼓励跨界别合作，扩大和改善为有需要的家庭提供的服务。

Hong Kong opens 10th community living room for subdivided-flat residents
Hong Kong's Chief Secretary for Administration attended the opening of the 10th community living room in North Point on 20 November 2026. The facility, serving subdivided-flat residents, is a partnership between the government, Swire Properties and St. James' Settlement, expected to serve 270 househ
Hong Kong's Chief Secretary for Administration on Friday 20 November 2026 attended the opening ceremony of the North Point community living room, the 10th such facility to begin service this year. The 2,400-square-foot space is expected to serve 270 subdivided-flat households and provide 43,000 visits per year.
The community living room initiative is a collaboration between the government, businesses and community organisations. The North Point facility is operated by St. James' Settlement and supported by Swire Properties and the Swire Group Charitable Trust, which provided the venue.
Speaking at the ceremony, the Chief Secretary said each community living room has its own character, and noted that this one had many children. He said he had spoken to several mothers who found the facility helpful, as it allows them to rest and socialise while their children play. The living room offers a children's play area, a kitchen, sewing activities and space for community interaction.
The Eastern District has the highest number of subdivided flats in Hong Kong Island. The new North Point living room follows the opening of a similar facility in Shau Kei in March 2025, expanding support for residents in the area.
St. James' Settlement, which also operates the Nam Cheong community living room, has provided homework tutoring, child development services, subsidy applications and resident support groups in the Eastern District since 2000. The organisation previously partnered with Swire Properties and the Swire Group Charitable Trust in 2022 to create a community space in Quarry Bay called 'She Qu' for workshops and exhibitions.
Professional social workers at the living room will proactively reach out to subdivided-flat households, identify high-risk families and provide counselling and referrals. The facility also offers tools, books and sports equipment for residents to share. The Chief Secretary said the government will continue to act as a facilitator, encouraging cross-sector cooperation to expand and improve services for families in need.

香港公务员推出多边时代管治系列讲座
香港公务员学院于2026年11月20日举办「多边时代的管治」系列第一场讲座。学院院长郭启良强调，在地缘政治转变中，香港作为值得信赖的多边合作平台的独特作用。超过220名高级官员
2026 年 11 月 20 日 19:05 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 20 日 19:18 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港特别行政区政府宣布，香港公务员学院于2026年11月20日举办“多边时代的管治”系列第一场讲座。学院院长郭本耀在开幕致辞中表示，当前地缘政治格局正在发生深刻变化，各国经济相互联系，没有一个国家能够孤立发展。
郭强调香港作为国际金融中心、全球贸易枢纽和重要战略门户的独特优势，并表示香港可以促进不同体系之间的对话，并为多边合作和争端解决提供值得信赖的平台。
来自59个政府决策局和部门的220多名高中级官员通过现场或网络方式参加了讲座。
“多边时代的治理”系列邀请全球、区域和地方领导人分享见解、经验和前瞻性观点。该系列旨在通过知识交流和讨论，培养公务员的战略思维，加深跨文化理解，加强对善政的共同承诺。
该活动是公务员学院举办的系列活动中的第一场，旨在帮助香港公职人员应对不断变化的世界秩序的挑战。

Hong Kong civil service launches lecture series on governance in multilateral era
The Civil Service College of Hong Kong held the first lecture of its 'Governance in a Multilateral Era' series on 20 November 2026. College Director Benjamin Kwok emphasised Hong Kong’s unique role as a trusted platform for multilateral cooperation amid geopolitical shifts. Over 220 senior officials
20 Nov 2026 at 19:05 HKT · updated 20 Nov, 19:18 · 1 min read
The Civil Service College of Hong Kong held the first lecture of its 'Governance in a Multilateral Era' series on 20 November 2026, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government announced. College Director Benjamin Kwok said in his opening remarks that the current geopolitical landscape was undergoing profound change, with economies interconnected and no country able to develop in isolation.
Kwok highlighted Hong Kong’s unique advantages as an international financial centre, global trade hub and strategically important gateway, saying the city could facilitate dialogue between different systems and provide a trusted platform for multilateral cooperation and dispute resolution.
More than 220 senior and middle-ranking officials from 59 government bureaux and departments attended the lecture, either in person or online.
The 'Governance in a Multilateral Era' series invites global, regional and local leaders to share insights, experience and forward-looking perspectives. The series aims to foster strategic thinking among civil servants, deepen cross-cultural understanding and strengthen a shared commitment to good governance through intellectual exchange and discussion.
The event was the first of the series, which is organised by the Civil Service College to equip Hong Kong’s public officials for the challenges of a changing world order.

香港展览探索自然数字与人工智能艺术的共生 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港展览探索自然数字与人工智能艺术的共生
香港视觉艺术中心的一个新展览利用 3D 打印雕塑和人工智能生成的艺术来探索自然与数字技术之间的关系。该展览将于11月20日至4月5日期间展出，展出艺术家谢炎安和黄天行以榕树桩为灵感创作的作品。
香港视觉艺术中心推出名为“色彩、生命、数码、种植”的新展览，探讨自然环境与数码技术的共存。展览由康乐及文化事务署主办，香港视觉艺术中心策划，展览期为11月20日至明年4月5日，地点为中环坚尼地道7A号，免费开放予公众参观。
展览以香港视觉艺术中心入口处的一棵榕树桩为创意起点。艺术家谢炎安和黄天行从香港公园的植物形态、自然环境和城市记忆中汲取灵感，将他们的自然观察和艺术想象转化为分布在中心不同楼层的3D打印雕塑装置。
这些作品结合了绘画、人工智能辅助生成、数字建模和3D打印。谢的鲜艳色彩和梦幻般的植物与黄的植物观察和数字开发的形式交织在一起。此次合作旨在引导参观者体验艺术与人工智能融合所产生的创造性可能性。
展览在香港视觉艺术中心一楼至五楼的公共空间举行。详细信息可在组织者的网站以及专门的 Facebook 和 Instagram 页面上查看。

Hong Kong exhibition explores nature-digital symbiosis with AI art
A new exhibition at Hong Kong Visual Arts Centre uses 3D-printed sculptures and AI-generated art to explore the relationship between nature and digital technology. Running from 20 November to 5 April, the show features works by artists Tse Yim-on and Wong Tin-hang inspired by a banyan tree stump.
The Hong Kong Visual Arts Centre has launched a new exhibition titled “Colour, Life, Digital, Planting” that explores the coexistence of natural environments and digital technology. Organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department and curated by the Hong Kong Visual Arts Centre, the exhibition runs from 20 November until 5 April next year at the centre’s premises at 7A Kennedy Road, Central, and is free to the public.
The exhibition takes as its creative starting point a banyan tree stump near the entrance of the Hong Kong Visual Arts Centre. Artists Tse Yim-on and Wong Tin-hang drew inspiration from plant forms, natural surroundings and urban memories found in Hong Kong Park, transforming their natural observations and artistic imagination into 3D-printed sculptural installations distributed across different floors of the centre.
The works combine painting, artificial-intelligence-assisted generation, digital modelling and 3D printing. Tse’s vivid colours and fantastical plants intertwine with Wong’s plant observations and digitally developed forms. The collaboration aims to guide visitors through the creative possibilities that arise from the fusion of art and artificial intelligence.
The exhibition is held in the public spaces from the first to the fifth floor of the Hong Kong Visual Arts Centre. Details are available on the organiser’s website, as well as on dedicated Facebook and Instagram pages.

content:
百度香港子公司因收购 Joyy 被罚款 75,000 美元中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
百度香港子公司因收购 Joyy 被罚款 75,000 美元
中国市场监管机构对百度控股的一家香港公司处以人民币 50 万元（合 74,938 美元）的罚款，原因是其未经批准完成了对直播平台运营商 Joyy 的部分收购。该交易涉及 Joyy 的 YY Live 业务，已于 2021 年 2 月部分执行，随后监管机构作出裁决
周五的一份官方声明显示，中国市场监管机构对科技巨头百度控股的一家香港公司处以人民币 50 万元（合 74,938 美元）的罚款，原因是其在未获得监管部门批准的情况下执行了涉及直播平台运营商 Joyy 的部分收购交易。
根据国家市场监督管理总局发布的声明，根据 2020 年签署的协议，这家香港公司获得了 Joyy 部分业务的独家控制权，其中包括与中国直播平台 YY Live 相关的业务。
声明称，部分交易于 2021 年 2 月在监管机构发布收购决定之前进行。
监管机构在 2026 年 11 月 20 日发布的一份声明中宣布了这一罚款，理由是违反了此类交易需要事先批准的竞争规则。
中国最大的互联网公司之一百度尚未对处罚公开发表评论。

Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Baidu's Hong Kong unit fined $75,000 over Joyy acquisition
China's market regulator fined a Baidu-controlled Hong Kong firm 500,000 yuan ($74,938) for completing part of an acquisition of live-streaming platform operator Joyy without approval. The deal, involving Joyy's YY Live business, was partially executed in February 2021 before the regulator ruled on
China's market regulator has fined a Hong Kong firm controlled by tech giant Baidu 500,000 yuan ($74,938) for carrying out part of an acquisition deal involving live-streaming platform operator Joyy without obtaining regulatory approval, an official statement showed on Friday.
The Hong Kong firm acquired sole control of part of Joyy's business, which included operations associated with live-streaming platform YY Live in China, under an agreement signed in 2020, according to the statement released by the State Administration for Market Regulation.
Part of the deal was carried out in February 2021, before the regulator issued its decision about the acquisition, the statement said.
The fine was announced in a statement published on 20 November 2026, with the regulator citing a breach of competition rules requiring prior approval for such transactions.
Baidu, one of China's largest internet companies, has not publicly commented on the penalty.

content:
启德体育园附近反非法劳工行动五人被捕 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
启德体育园附近反非法劳工行动拘捕五人
香港当局于11月13日至17日在启德体育公园附近的一次联合行动中逮捕了五名涉嫌非法劳工的人。该行动针对重大活动期间的非法劳工、假冒伪劣商品摊贩和倒卖门票行为。移民局警告违规者
2026 年 11 月 20 日 18:06 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 20 日 18:18 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
香港入境事务处联同香港海关、警方、食物环境卫生署及康乐及文化事务署于11月13日至15日及17日在启德体育公园附近进行联合行动。此次行动的目标是非法劳工、销售假货的流动小贩以及大型活动期间未经授权的音乐会门票销售。
警方在行动中拘捕五名涉嫌非法劳工，其中包括一名男子和四名女子，年龄介乎21岁至31岁。入境处和其他当局表示，他们会在重大活动期间保持高能见度的巡逻和执法。
入境处发言人表示：“任何人违反其适用的逗留条件，即属犯罪。同时，所有旅客未经入境事务处处长批准，不论有薪或无薪，均不得在香港从事任何工作。违例者将被检控，一经定罪，最高可被罚款港币五万元及监禁两年。协助或教唆他人违反逗留条件的人同样有罪。”
移民部遵循既定的标准程序来筛查和识别人口贩运和强迫劳动的受害者。所有在行动中被捕的弱势群体，包括非法劳工、非法移民、性工作者和外籍家庭佣工，都会接受初步评估。如果出现任何贩运或强迫劳动的迹象，官员将使用标准清单进行全面调查，以确定是否存在贩运或强迫劳动因素。
已确定的人口贩运和强迫劳动受害者可以获得各种支持和援助，包括紧急干预、医疗诊断和治疗、咨询、庇护或临时住所以及其他支持服务。移民局敦促人口贩卖和强迫劳动的受害者立即向有关当局举报此类犯罪行为。
市民可致电专用热线185 185、传真号码2824 1166、电邮[email protected]举报非法雇佣活动，或在入境事务处网站www.immd.gov.hk填写「网上举报违反入境条例的行为」表格。

Five arrested in anti-illegal labour operation near Kai Tak Sports Park | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Five arrested in anti-illegal labour operation near Kai Tak Sports Park
Hong Kong authorities arrested five people suspected of being illegal workers during a joint operation near Kai Tak Sports Park from 13 to 17 November. The operation targeted illegal labour, counterfeit goods vendors and ticket touting during major events. The Immigration Department warned violators
20 Nov 2026 at 18:06 HKT · updated 20 Nov, 18:18 · 2 min read
Hong Kong's Immigration Department, together with the Customs and Excise Department, Police, Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, conducted a joint operation near Kai Tak Sports Park from 13 to 15 and 17 November. The operation targeted illegal labour, mobile hawkers selling counterfeit goods and unauthorised ticket sales for concerts during major events.
Officers arrested five suspected illegal workers during the operation, comprising one man and four women aged between 21 and 31. The Immigration Department and other authorities said they would maintain high-visibility patrols and enforcement during major events.
An Immigration Department spokesman said: "Anyone who violates the conditions of stay valid for them commits an offence. At the same time, all visitors, without the approval of the Director of Immigration, whether paid or unpaid, must not engage in any employment in Hong Kong. Offenders will be prosecuted and, upon conviction, face a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for two years. Those who assist or abet others in violating their conditions of stay are equally guilty."
The Immigration Department follows established standard procedures to screen and identify victims of human trafficking and forced labour. All vulnerable individuals arrested in operations, including illegal workers, illegal immigrants, sex workers and foreign domestic helpers, undergo an initial assessment. If any indicators of trafficking or forced labour emerge, officers conduct a full investigation using a standard checklist to determine whether trafficking or forced labour elements are present.
Identified victims of human trafficking and forced labour receive various support and assistance, including emergency intervention, medical diagnosis and treatment, counselling, shelter or temporary accommodation and other support services. The Immigration Department urged victims of human trafficking and forced labour to immediately report such crimes to the relevant authorities.
Members of the public can report illegal employment activities via the dedicated hotline 185 185, fax number 2824 1166, email [email protected], or by completing the "Online Reporting of Offences against the Immigration Ordinance" form on the Immigration Department's website at www.immd.gov.hk.

content:
香港报告两例输入性登革热病例，一例基孔肯雅热病例 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港报告两宗外地传入登革热个案及一宗基孔肯雅热个案
香港卫生防护中心报告截至11月19日当周新增两宗输入性登革热个案及一宗输入性基孔肯雅热个案。该市今年已记录了 42 例登革热病例和 9 例基孔肯雅热病例。当局敦促旅客采取预防措施，预防蚊媒疾病。
香港卫生防护中心于2026年11月13日至11月19日一周内报告两宗输入性登革热个案及一宗输入性基孔肯雅热个案。登革热病人在潜伏期内曾到过越南及柬埔寨，而基孔肯雅病人为一名71岁男子，曾到访中国内地，现时情况稳定。
今年至今，香港已录得42宗登革热个案，其中40宗为外地传入，2宗为本地感染。相比之下，2025年有59例，2024年有161例，除2024年有5例本地病例外，均为输入性病例。就基孔肯雅热而言，该市今年已确诊9例，其中8例输入性病例，1例本地感染病例，低于2025年的82例，其中11例本地病例。
在全球范围内，世界卫生组织报告 2024 年登革热病例超过 1400 万例，创历史新高。去年，超过 90 个国家报告了超过 500 万例病例和 4,000 多人死亡。今年1月至9月，约有250万例病例和1,500多人死亡。登革热在许多热门旅游目的地仍然流行，孟加拉国、柬埔寨、斯里兰卡和越南今年各报告了超过 10 万例病例；印度尼西亚超过90,000；马来西亚超过80,000；印度超过70,000；新加坡超过3,000。据广东省疾控部门称，截至9月，广东省报告了586例病例，仅9月份就有155例。
对于基孔肯雅热，世界卫生组织的数据显示，截至 10 月，全球已有 363,307 例病例和 122 人死亡，其中美洲和东南亚的人数最多。截至9月，广东省报告病例1,753例，其中9月1,014例，较7月和8月的171例大幅上升至496例。
卫生防护中心提醒居民在港及外游时，特别是前往东南亚时，应保持环境卫生并采取防蚊措施。建议使用含有避蚊胺或其他有效活性成分的驱虫剂，孕妇使用浓度限制为30%，儿童使用浓度限制为10%，两个月或以上儿童前往受影响地区时使用浓度限制为30%。食物环境卫生署呼吁市民消除蚊虫孳生地，例如每周更换花瓶水、清理积水、保持排水沟清洁等。居民可拨打1823报告蚊虫问题。

Hong Kong reports two imported dengue cases, one chikungunya case | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong reports two imported dengue cases, one chikungunya case
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reported two imported dengue fever cases and one imported chikungunya case in the week to 19 November. The city has recorded 42 dengue and nine chikungunya cases this year. Authorities urged travellers to take precautions against mosquito-borne diseases.
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection (CHP) reported two imported dengue fever cases and one imported chikungunya case in the week from 13 November to 19 November 2026. The dengue patients had travelled to Vietnam and Cambodia during their incubation periods, while the chikungunya patient, a 71-year-old man, had visited mainland China and is in stable condition.
So far this year, Hong Kong has recorded 42 dengue cases, including 40 imported and two local infections. This compares with 59 cases in 2025 and 161 in 2024, all of which were imported except for five local cases in 2024. For chikungunya, the city has confirmed nine cases this year, comprising eight imported and one local infection, down from 82 cases in 2025, which included 11 local cases.
Globally, the World Health Organization reported over 14 million dengue cases in 2024, a record high. Last year, more than 90 countries reported over 5 million cases and over 4,000 deaths. From January to September this year, about 2.5 million cases and over 1,500 deaths were recorded. Dengue remains prevalent in many popular travel destinations, with Bangladesh, Cambodia, Sri Lanka and Vietnam each reporting over 100,000 cases this year; Indonesia over 90,000; Malaysia over 80,000; India over 70,000; and Singapore over 3,000. Guangdong Province recorded 586 cases up to September, with 155 in September alone, according to its disease control authority.
For chikungunya, WHO data show 363,307 cases and 122 deaths globally up to October, with the highest numbers in the Americas and Southeast Asia. Guangdong recorded 1,753 cases up to September, including 1,014 in September, a sharp rise from 171–496 in July and August.
The CHP reminded residents to maintain environmental hygiene and take mosquito-prevention measures both in Hong Kong and when travelling, especially to Southeast Asia. It recommended using insect repellent containing DEET or other effective active ingredients, with concentration limits of 30 per cent for pregnant women and 10 per cent for children, or 30 per cent for children aged two months or older when travelling to affected areas. The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department urged the public to eliminate mosquito breeding sites, such as changing flower vase water weekly, clearing stagnant water, and keeping drains clean. Residents can report mosquito problems by calling 1823.

summary: 香港青年局于2026年创业日设立大湾区创新基地展馆 |中国劳工公告 星期五, 2026年11月20日 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 香港青年局于2026年创业日设立大湾区创新基地展馆 香港青年局于2026年创业日设立展馆并举办研讨会，支持大湾区青年创业。马丽丽司长强调政府对香港第一个五年计划的支持，欢迎四位新联盟成员，并重点介绍了超过 480 项活动。
content:
香港青年局于2026年创业日设立大湾区创新基地展馆 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港青年局于2026年创业日设立大湾区创新基地展馆
香港青年局于2026年创业日设立展馆并举办研讨会，支持大湾区青年创业。马晓春书记强调政府对香港第一个五年计划的支持，欢迎四位新的联盟成员，并重点介绍了 480 多项活动
香港特别行政区政府民政及青年局于11月20日为“大湾区香港青年创新创业基地联盟”设立展馆，并于“创业日2026”举办专题研讨会，支持青年人追寻创业梦想。
民政及青年局局长马桂梅在研讨会上致开幕辞。她表示，政府高度重视青少年发展。她表示，香港特别行政区经济和社会发展第一个五年规划（2026至2030年）强调为青年人拓展发展空间，支持他们追逐梦想。政府致力帮助青年抓住粤港澳大湾区机遇，利用联盟激发创新创业活力。
马云表示，粤港两地政府为大湾区青年创业提供了一系列支持政策，大湾区创业氛围日益浓厚。她感谢广东省人民政府港澳事务办公室、广东省人力资源和社会保障厅对联盟工作的大力支持。 HYB将继续通过联盟加强与利益相关方的合作，支持香港青年在大湾区创业，积极参与大湾区发展，更好地融入和服务国家发展战略。
此次研讨会以“汇聚联盟力量，助力青年实现创业梦想”为主题，来自HYB大湾区青年创业资助计划的代表、青年创业团队、大湾区创新创业基地代表以及参加APEC青年创业大会的香港青年代表团成员齐聚一堂。他们分享了联盟成员如何与青年创业团队紧密合作，发挥合力，帮助香港青年在大湾区创新创业，并分享了参加国际会议的经验和收获。 HYB还邀请了大湾区内地九市创新创业基地代表，介绍当地创业政策和基地服务，帮助青年创业者更好地了解如何在大湾区创业发展，增强他们在大湾区创新创业的能力和信心。
研讨会期间还举行了联盟新成员欢迎仪式，迎来了四家新成员单位，进一步拓展了联盟在大​​湾区的创新创业基地网络。
该联盟由HYB、广东省政府港澳办于2023年12月联合发起

Hong Kong youth bureau sets up GBA innovation base pavilion at Startup Day 2026 | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong youth bureau sets up GBA innovation base pavilion at Startup Day 2026
The Hong Kong Youth Bureau set up a pavilion and held a seminar at Startup Day 2026 to support youth entrepreneurship in the Greater Bay Area. Secretary Alice Ma stressed government backing under the city's first five-year plan, welcomed four new alliance members, and highlighted over 480 activities
The Home and Youth Bureau (HYB) of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government set up a pavilion for the Greater Bay Area Hong Kong Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurship Base Alliance and held a thematic seminar at Startup Day 2026 on 20 November, to support young people in pursuing their entrepreneurial dreams.
Secretary for Home and Youth Alice Ma Kwai-mei delivered opening remarks at the seminar. She said the government attaches great importance to youth development. She noted that the First Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (2026–2030) emphasises broadening development space for young people and supporting them in pursuing their dreams. The government is committed to helping youth seize opportunities in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), using the alliance to stimulate innovation and entrepreneurial vitality.
Ma said that both Guangdong and Hong Kong governments have provided a range of support policies for young people who wish to start businesses in the GBA, and the entrepreneurial atmosphere in the region is growing stronger. She thanked the Guangdong Provincial Government's Office of Hong Kong and Macao Affairs and the Guangdong Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security for their strong support of the alliance's work. HYB will continue to strengthen cooperation with stakeholders through the alliance to support Hong Kong youth in starting businesses in the GBA, actively participate in the GBA's development, and better integrate into and serve the national development strategy.
The seminar, themed “Pooling the Alliance's Strength to Support Youth in Pursuing Their Entrepreneurial Dreams”, brought together representatives from HYB's GBA Youth Entrepreneurship Grant Scheme, youth startup teams, GBA innovation and entrepreneurship base representatives, and members of the Chinese Hong Kong youth delegation that attended the APEC Young Entrepreneurs Conference. They shared how alliance members cooperate closely with youth startup teams to create synergy and help Hong Kong youth innovate and start businesses in the GBA, and also shared their experiences and gains from participating in international meetings. HYB also invited representatives from innovation and entrepreneurship bases in nine mainland GBA cities to introduce local entrepreneurship policies and base services, helping young entrepreneurs better understand how to set up and develop in the GBA, and enhancing their ability and confidence to innovate and start businesses there.
A welcome ceremony for new alliance members was held during the seminar, welcoming four new member organisations, further expanding the alliance's network of innovation and entrepreneurship bases across the GBA.
The alliance was jointly launched in December 2023 by HYB, the Guangdong Provincial Government's Office of Hong Kong and Macao Affairs, and the Guangdong Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security. It brings together about 70 member organisations from various sectors in Guangdong and Hong Kong, providing a one-stop platform for information, promotion and exchange. In nearly three years since its establishment, members of the alliance have organised more than 480 activities of different types in Guangdong and Hong Kong, supporting young entrepreneurs at different development stages, helping them expand their networks and improve their competitiveness. The alliance's innovation and entrepreneurship bases now cover all nine mainland cities in the GBA.

content:
新鸿基地产委任叶刘淑仪为独立董事 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
新鸿基地产委任叶刘淑仪为独立董事
新鸿基地产任命香港资深政坛人物叶刘淑仪为独立非执行董事，年薪为30万港元。开发商在周五的一份文件中披露了这一任命。
据周五提交的文件显示，新鸿基地产(0016)已任命叶刘淑仪为独立非执行董事，任命于周五生效。叶先生现年 76 岁，是行政会议的召集人及非官方成员，每年将收取 30 万港元的费用。
叶先生是新民党、萨凡塔斯政策研究所和海上丝绸之路协会的创会主席，也是全球繁荣峰会的创始人。文件称，叶先生在过去三年内没有在任何其他上市公司担任任何其他董事职务，并且与开发商的任何其他董事、高级管理人员、主要股东或控股股东没有关系。
她毕业于香港大学，获得一等荣誉文学学士学位，并拥有格拉斯哥大学文学硕士学位、斯坦福大学管理学理学硕士学位和东亚研究文学硕士学位。叶先生于1975年9月加入香港公务员队伍，曾在多个政策领域工作，包括民政事务、保安、贸易及工业。

Sun Hung Kai Properties appoints Regina Ip as independent director | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Sun Hung Kai Properties appoints Regina Ip as independent director
Sun Hung Kai Properties has named Regina Ip, a senior Hong Kong political figure, as an independent non-executive director with an annual fee of HK$300,000. The developer disclosed the appointment in a filing on Friday.
Sun Hung Kai Properties (0016) has appointed Regina Ip Lau Suk-yee as an independent non-executive director, effective on Friday, according to a filing on Friday. Ip, 76, is the convenor and a non-official member of the Executive Council and will receive a fee of HK$300,000 per annum for the role.
Ip is the founding chairperson of the New People's Party, the Savantas Policy Institute and the Maritime Silk Road Society, and the founder of the Global Prosperity Summit. The filing said Ip did not hold any other directorships in any other public companies in the last three years and has no relationship with any other directors, senior management, substantial shareholders or controlling shareholders of the developer.
She graduated from The University of Hong Kong with a first class honours degree in Bachelor of Arts and holds a Master of Letters degree from University of Glasgow, a Master of Science degree in Management, and a Master of Arts degree in East Asian Studies, both from Stanford University. Ip joined the administrative service of the Hong Kong civil service in September 1975 and worked in a wide range of policy areas, including home affairs, security, trade and industry.

title: Jockey Club early childhood project benefits over 70,000 children in a decade
zh_title: 赛马会幼儿计划十年惠及逾七万名儿童
summary: 赛马会幼儿项目十年惠及逾七万名儿童 |中国劳工布告栏 星期五, 2026 年 11 月 20 日 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 赛马会幼儿项目十年内惠及超过 70,000 名儿童 KeySteps@JC 是香港赛马会慈善信托基金于 2017 年推出的一项计划，耗资超过 8.13 亿港元，已为六个地区超过 70,000 名六岁以下儿童及其家庭提供支持。该项目集医疗、教育、社会服务于一体，为14000多名7万以下儿童提供集中救助
content:
赛马会幼儿项目十年惠及逾七万名儿童 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
赛马会幼儿计划十年惠及逾七万名儿童
KeySteps@JC 是香港赛马会慈善信托基金于 2017 年推出的一项计划，耗资超过 8.13 亿港元，已为六个地区超过 70,000 名六岁以下儿童及其家人提供支持。该项目集医疗、教育、社会服务于一体，为14000名贫困人口提供集中救助
该组织周五表示，过去十年，通过香港赛马会慈善信托基金资助的一项计划，超过 70,000 名六岁以下儿童及其家人获得了必要的发展和福利支持。
KeySteps@JC 于 2017 年推出，获批捐款超过 8.13 亿港元，在回顾近十年幼儿发展多学科工作的研讨会上分享了其重要里程碑和研究成果。该倡议将医疗保健专业人员、教育工作者和社会服务提供者聚集在一个综合框架下，以解决早期学习需求、家庭复原力和整体儿童福祉。
该项目覆盖九龙城、深水埗、沙田、屯门、元朗和大埔六个基层地区，为家庭、学校和当地社区提供协调一致的护理。除了普遍推广外，该计划还为大约 14,000 名儿童提供了密集的专门援助，帮助了 1,500 名教育和社会服务从业人员，并支持 134 所幼儿园改善其教育环境。
高层社区领袖和官员出席了周五的颁奖典礼，其中包括劳工及福利局局长孙宇晨和赛马会董事霍启刚，以及超过 200 名教育工作者、医疗保健专家、学者和福利合作伙伴。霍克在会上致辞时指出，KeySteps@JC的成就突显了及时、早期干预的必要性以及联合多个专业部门的有效性。他强调，俱乐部的目标是通过与社区利益相关者的持续合作，在这些成果的基础上再接再厉，确保幼儿能够获得高质量的发展资源。
霍克补充说，该倡议与政府更广泛的社会福利战略密切相关，特别是其侧重于早期预防、增强家庭复原力以及巩固儿童和家庭福利框架的五年计划。该计划的一个主要特点是创建专门的地区中心，作为专门为幼儿设计的一站式社区资源中心。这些设施是在孩子们自己的积极参与下开发的，提供了一个无障碍、非污名化的环境，家庭可以在这里寻求早期筛查、亲子活动和量身定制的咨询。
项目团队提出的研究结果表明，连接家庭、学校和福利机构可以显着改善低收入家庭幼儿的发展成果。项目数据表明，积极倾听儿童的声音并让他们直接参与服务设计可以显着提高社区支持网络的有效性。
幼儿福利仍然是赛马会的核心慈善重点

Jockey Club early childhood project benefits over 70,000 children in a decade | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Jockey Club early childhood project benefits over 70,000 children in a decade
KeySteps@JC, a Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust initiative launched in 2017 with over HK$813 million, has supported more than 70,000 children under six and their families across six districts. The project integrates healthcare, education, and social services, providing intensive aid to 14,000 c
More than 70,000 children under the age of six and their families have received essential developmental and welfare support over the past decade through an initiative funded by the Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust, the organisation said on Friday.
Launched in 2017 with an approved donation exceeding HK$813 million, KeySteps@JC shared its key milestones and research findings during a symposium reviewing nearly ten years of multidisciplinary work in early childhood development. The initiative brings together healthcare professionals, educators, and social service providers under an integrated framework to address early learning needs, family resilience, and overall childhood well-being.
Operating across six grassroots districts—Kowloon City, Sham Shui Po, Sha Tin, Tuen Mun, Yuen Long, and Tai Po—the project provides coordinated care spanning homes, schools, and local communities. In addition to universal outreach, the program has delivered intensive, specialised assistance to approximately 14,000 children, assisted 1,500 education and social service practitioners, and supported 134 kindergartens in improving their educational environments.
High-level community leaders and officials attended Friday's presentation ceremony, including Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun and Jockey Club Steward Kenneth Fok, along with more than 200 educators, healthcare specialists, academics, and welfare partners. Speaking at the gathering, Fok noted that the achievements of KeySteps@JC highlight the necessity of timely, early intervention and the effectiveness of uniting multiple professional sectors. He emphasised that the club aims to build upon these results through ongoing collaboration with community stakeholders, ensuring that young children have access to high-quality developmental resources.
Fok added that the initiative closely aligns with the administration's broader social welfare strategy, particularly its five-year plan focused on early prevention, strengthening household resilience, and consolidating child and family welfare frameworks. A key feature of the program has been the creation of specialised district hubs, serving as one-stop community resource centres designed specifically for young children. Developed with active input from the children themselves, the facilities offer an accessible, non-stigmatising environment where families can seek early screening, parent-child activities, and tailored counselling.
Research findings presented by the project team indicate that connecting homes, schools, and welfare institutions significantly improves developmental outcomes for young children from lower-income households. The project data demonstrated that actively listening to children's voices and involving them directly in service design markedly enhances the effectiveness of community support networks.
Early childhood welfare remains a core philanthropic focus for the Jockey Club, which also backs several complementary schemes, including projects aimed at early intervention for vulnerable infants and initiatives upgrading educare standards for toddlers under three years old. Through its integrated business and charity model, the Club generated HK$39.3 billion for the community in the 2025/26 financial year, including HK$30.7 billion in government duties and Lotteries Fund contributions alongside HK$8.6 billion in approved charitable donations.

香港因气温下降开设18个临时避寒所中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 20 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港因气温下降开设18个临时避寒中心
民政事务总署已在全港开设18个临时避寒中心，免费提供寝具、热食和水。捐款必须向工作人员登记。
民政事务总署已启动全港18个临时避寒中心，为有需要的人士免费提供干净的寝具、毯子、热食和热水。避难所自 2026 年 11 月 20 日起开放。
为确保安静、不受干扰的休息环境，任何个人或团体向避难所使用者捐赠物品，必须先联系避难所工作人员登记，然后将物品放置在指定的室内位置。工作人员将告知用户相关安排，以便他们自行领取物品。
需要使用避寒中心或查询物品捐赠安排的人士，可致电民政事务总署热线2572 8427。
18个临时避寒中心分布于港岛、九龙及新界。在港岛区，避难所包括位于西营盘高街 2 号的西区社区综合大楼；福荫道7号铜锣湾社区中心；鸭脷洲利东村利东社区会堂；及位于皇后大道东258号的湾仔活动中心。
九龙区的避难所位于庇利街42号九龙城政府合署内的红磡社区会堂；碧云道223号蓝田(东)社区会堂；深水埗长新里1号南竹社区中心；位于钻石山凤德道111号的凤德社区中心；及位于中辉街 60 号的粮石里油麻地社区中心。
在新界区，避难所包括位于文东路 39 号的东涌社区会堂；葵涌大窝口道15号大窝口社区中心；粉岭长康社区会堂；将军澳培成路38号坑口社区会堂；沙田龙轩社区中心；香思辉街2号大埔社区中心；荃湾鲤树社区会堂；屯门湖山路101号湖山路社区会堂；及元朗朗屏社区会堂。
只要寒冷天气警告生效，避寒所就会保持开放，并密切监测情况。

Hong Kong opens 18 temporary cold shelters as temperatures drop | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 20 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong opens 18 temporary cold shelters as temperatures drop
The Home Affairs Department has opened 18 temporary cold shelters across Hong Kong, providing free bedding, hot meals and water. Donations must be registered with staff.
The Home Affairs Department has activated 18 temporary cold shelters across Hong Kong, offering free clean bedding, blankets, hot food and hot water to those in need. The shelters are open from 20 November 2026.
To ensure a quiet and undisturbed rest environment, any individuals or groups wishing to donate items to shelter users must first contact shelter staff to register, then place items in designated indoor locations. Staff will inform users about the arrangement so they can collect items themselves.
Those who need to use a cold shelter or inquire about item donation arrangements can call the Home Affairs Department hotline at 2572 8427.
The 18 temporary cold shelters are located across Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and the New Territories. On Hong Kong Island, shelters include the Western District Community Complex at 2 High Street, Sai Ying Pun; the Causeway Bay Community Centre at 7 Fook Yam Road; the Lei Tung Community Hall on Lei Tung Estate, Ap Lei Chau; and the Wan Chai Activity Centre at 258 Queen's Road East.
In Kowloon, shelters are at the Hung Hom Community Hall in the Kowloon City Government Offices at 42 Bailey Street; the Lam Tin (East) Community Hall at 223 Pik Wan Road; the Nam Chuk Community Centre at 1 Cheung San Lane, Sham Shui Po; the Fung Tak Community Centre at 111 Fung Tak Road, Diamond Hill; and the Liang Shir Li Yau Ma Tei Community Centre at 60 Chung Fai Street.
In the New Territories, shelters include the Tung Chung Community Hall at 39 Man Tung Road; the Tai Wo Hau Community Centre at 15 Tai Wo Hau Road, Kwai Chung; the Cheung Hong Community Hall in Fanling; the Hang Hau Community Hall at 38 Pui Shing Road, Tseung Kwan O; the Lung Hin Community Centre in Sha Tin; the Tai Po Community Centre at 2 Heung Sze Fai Street; the Lei Shue Tree Community Hall in Tsuen Wan; the Wu Shan Road Community Hall at 101 Wu Shan Road, Tuen Mun; and the Long Ping Community Hall in Yuen Long.
The cold shelters will remain open as long as cold weather warnings are in effect, with the department monitoring conditions closely.

title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
zh_title: 与中国有关的黑客利用关键的 VMware vCenter 零日漏洞获取管理员访问权限并窃取数据
summary: 与中国有关的黑客利用关键的 VMware vCenter 零日漏洞来获取管理员访问权限并窃取数据与中国有关的黑客利用关键的 VMware vCenter 零日漏洞来获取管理员访问权限并窃取数据Swati Khandelwalp2026 年 11 月 20 日漏洞/网络间谍活动 被称为 Armory Castle（以前称为 UNC5221）的涉嫌与中国关系的网络间谍组织已被归咎于2026 年 9 月上旬，VMware vCenter Server 中的一个关键安全漏洞被零日利用。该漏洞被追踪为 CVE-2026-123890（CVSS 评分：9.8），是 VMware Directory S 中的身份验证绕过案例。
content:
与中国有关的黑客利用关键的 VMware vCenter 零日漏洞获取管理员访问权限并窃取数据
与中国有关的黑客利用关键的 VMware vCenter 零日漏洞获取管理员访问权限并窃取数据
Swati Khandelwal报告2026年11月20日漏洞/网络间谍活动
涉嫌与中国有联系的网络间谍组织 Armoury Castle（以前称为 UNC5221）被归因于 2026 年 9 月上旬对 VMware vCenter Server 中一个关键安全漏洞的零日利用。
该漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-123890（CVSS 评分：9.8），是 VMware Directory Service 中的身份验证绕过案例，可被利用来获得对系统的未经授权的访问。
它已作为 2026 年 11 月 19 日发布的补丁的一部分在以下版本中得到解决 -
VMware Cloud Foundation、VMware vSphere Foundation 9.1.x.x - 已在 9.1.1.0200 中修复
VMware Cloud Foundation、VMware vSphere Foundation 9.0.x.x - 已在 9.0.2.0200 中修复
VMware vCenter 8.0 - 在 8.0 U3m 中修复
VMware vCenter 7.0（如果有扩展支持合同，请联系 Broadcom 支持）
VMware Cloud Foundation - 已在 5.2.5 中修复
VMware Telco Cloud Platform - 在 vCenter 8.0 U3m 中已修复（TCI：3.0、TCP：3.0、4.x、5.0.x、5.1.x、5.2）
VMware Telco 云基础架构 - 在 vCenter 8.0 U3m 中已修复（TCI：3.0、TCP：3.0、4.x、5.0.x、5.1.x、5.2）
谷歌威胁情报小组和 Mandiant 表示：“CVE-2026-123890 是分布式计算环境/远程过程调用 (DCE/RPC) 上未经身份验证的安全远程密码 (SRP-6a) 会话密钥泄露漏洞。”
“成功利用该漏洞会导致远程身份验证绕过，从而创建一个以administrator@vsphere.local 身份建立的经过身份验证的会话。”
攻击者可以利用该漏洞获取经过身份验证的管理员会话、执行任意命令并使用目录服务（“vmdird”）获取文件，例如 data.mdb 数据库。这家科技巨头的威胁情报和事件响应团队表示，他们观察到中国黑客组织使用名为 BONESAW 的实用程序将该漏洞武器化。
谷歌表示：“BONESAW 是一个主要是为了促进用 Golang 编写的远程攻击而构建的实用程序，它利用 CVE-2026-123890 来窃取任意闪电内存映射数据库 (LMDB)、劫持 SAML 安全令牌服务 (STS) 并创建单点登录 (SSO) 管理员帐户。”
该活动是同一活动的一部分，该活动还涉及利用 BeyondTrust Remote Support 中当时的零日漏洞（CVE-2026-102764，CVSS 评分：9.3）进行侦察、获取管理控制、建立持久性并部署名为 BARECLAW 的定制代理隧道器。
据称，威胁行为者已从远程支持设备横向转移到内部 Linux 设备，将权限升级为 root，并部署额外的有效负载以扩大其访问范围、绘制环境图、进行数据盗窃并进入虚拟化环境。
谷歌表示：“该组织利用 nmap 扫描内部环境，查找运行特定于 VMware 的开放端口的系统，即端口 9080、5480 和 2012。” “值得注意的是，端口 2012 用作 vCenter Single Sign-On (SSO) 的控制接口 RPC，并且是 Armory Castle 通过 BONESAW 远程利用 CVE-2026-123890 的一个组成部分。”
作为攻击的一部分，部署了六个已识别的恶意软件系列和实用程序 -
SLIMSAVAGE 和 CAGEMATCH，JSP Web shell，旨在运行任意命令、暂存有效负载并建立

【原文 English Original】
China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
Swati KhandelwalNov 20, 2026Vulnerability / Cyber Espionage
The suspected China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a critical security flaw in VMware vCenter Server in early September 2026.
The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123890 (CVSS score: 9.8), is a case of authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service that could be exploited to gain unauthorized access to the system.
It has been addressed as part of patches released on November 19, 2026, in the following versions -
VMware Cloud Foundation, VMware vSphere Foundation 9.1.x.x - Fixed in 9.1.1.0200
VMware Cloud Foundation, VMware vSphere Foundation 9.0.x.x - Fixed in 9.0.2.0200
VMware vCenter 8.0 - Fixed in 8.0 U3m
VMware vCenter 7.0 (Contact Broadcom Support, if on extended support contract)
VMware Cloud Foundation - Fixed in 5.2.5
VMware Telco Cloud Platform - Fixed in vCenter 8.0 U3m (TCI: 3.0, TCP: 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2)
VMware Telco Cloud Infrastructure - Fixed in vCenter 8.0 U3m (TCI: 3.0, TCP: 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2)
"CVE-2026-123890 is an unauthenticated Secure Remote Password (SRP-6a) session key disclosure vulnerability over Distributed Computing Environment/Remote Procedure Calls (DCE/RPC)," Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant said.
"Successful exploitation results in a remote authentication bypass which creates an authenticated session established as administrator@vsphere.local."
An attacker can exploit the vulnerability to obtain an authenticated administrator session, execute arbitrary commands, and acquire files, such as the data.mdb database, by using the Directory Service ("vmdird"). The tech giant's threat intelligence and incident response teams said it observed the Chinese hacking group weaponizing the flaw using a utility dubbed BONESAW.
"BONESAW is a utility primarily built to facilitate remote exploitation written in Golang, which utilizes CVE-2026-123890 to exfiltrate the arbitrary Lightning Memory-Mapped Database (LMDB), hijack the SAML Security Token Service (STS), and create a Single Sign On (SSO) Administrator account," Google said.
The activity is part of the same campaign that also involved the exploitation of a then zero-day vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764, CVSS score: 9.3) to conduct reconnaissance, obtain administrative control, establish persistence, and deploy a bespoke proxy tunneler called BARECLAW.
From the Remote Support device, the threat actor is said to have moved laterally to an internal Linux appliance, escalated privileges to root, and deployed additional payloads to broaden their access, map the environment, conduct data theft, and move into the virtualized environment.
"The group leveraged nmap to scan the internal environment for systems running open ports specific to VMware, namely ports 9080, 5480, and 2012," Google said. "Notably, port 2012 is used as the control interface RPC for vCenter Single Sign-On (SSO) and is an integral part of Armory Castle's remote exploitation of CVE-2026-123890 through BONESAW."
Deployed as part of the attack are six identified malware families and utilities -
SLIMSAVAGE and CAGEMATCH, JSP web shells designed to run arbitrary commands, stage payloads, and establish a foothold on the Linux appliance.
BONESAW, the Golang-based remote exploitation utility for CVE-2026-123890 used to target an internal vCenter Server.
SAWSNAKE, a Golang utility that enables vCenter SAML authentication bypass and session cookie generation, thereby making it possible to conduct Golden SAML attacks against vCenter following the successful execution of BONESAW and allowing the attacker to forge authentication tokens, bypass multi-factor authentication(MFA), and impersonate any user. It's a Go-based port of an open-source Python script named "vcenter_saml_login.py."
BEARBONES, a C backdoor based on the open-source Dropbear SSH Server that's capable of bypassing system password authentication, logging plaintext credentials, and loading or generating server host keys from the temporary directory.
LAZYBONES, a lightweight Go backdoor that uses Slack for command-and-control (C2) communications and has been previously deployed in a separate intrusion in early 2025 following the successful exploitation of a critical flaw in Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2025-22457, CVSS score: 9.0).
It's suspected that Armory Castle had knowledge of the flaw prior to the disclosure of CVE-2026-59309 on July 29, 2026, with the recovered BONESAW binary containing a build timestamp of July 13, 2026. However, it's worth noting that build metadata can be modified before compilation.
"After the execution of BEARBONES to create a listener on TCP port 33992, Armory Castle moved laterally to the vCenter appliance as the Administrator and created a local administrator account named sps-<REDACTED>@vsphere.local," Google said.
"Notably, Armory Castle enabled SSH on vCenter via the vCenter Server Appliance Management Interface (VAMI) API through a PUT request to /rest/appliance/access/ssh. After enabling SSH, Armory Castle connected to the vCenter via SSH using the newly created local administrator account."
In the final stage of the attack, the adversary was found enumerating the ESXi file system, mounting Virtual Machine File System (VMFS) volumes, and adding an SSH public key to the root account's authorized keys. It also conducted additional reconnaissance and data theft on the ESXi file system, which were then archived and downloaded via HTTP GET requests to the Remote Support appliance for subsequent exfiltration.
Furthermore, the attackers have been observed dropping LAZYBONES to a separate Linux appliance, which periodically checks for commands from a designated Slack channel, allowing it to perform command execution, file transfer, and beacon interval adjustment.
CVE-2026-123890 is the second vulnerability in a VMware product to be exploited by Armory Castle as a zero-day this year alone. Late last month, CrowdStrike revealed it identified incidents where the hacking crew abused CVE-2026-41709 (CVSS score: 2.7), an insufficient logging flaw in VMware ESX, to reduce audit trail visibility.
"BONESAW represents a significant expansion into post-compromise use of zero-days," Google said. "The group's use of VMware-specific tools like SAWSNAKE and vmfs_browser.py, alongside malware designed to operate on Remote Support and Linux systems, represent a diverse toolset including capabilities specifically tailored to target several different appliances, demonstrating the threat actor's deep understanding of each."
"The use of three separate specialized sets of malware and two zero-days in the course of a single campaign indicates that there are significant resources supporting Armory Castle operations. It also shows the extent of the threat actor's operational commitment to compromise high-priority targets."

title: 中國驚現「鬼城機場」 前10個月客流量為零

content:
圖為中國東方航空公司一架客機從北京大興國際機場起飛。(STR / AFP)
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵報導）中共當局多年大興基建，機場建設過剩問題正逐漸浮現。最新數據顯示，中國超過七成運輸機場年旅客吞吐量不足200萬人次，部分機場今年前10個月客流量為零或個位數，被稱為「鬼城機場」。但這些機場仍依靠政府補貼維持基本運營。
據「第一財經」報導，航班管家DAST的數據顯示，2026年1月至10月，重慶仙女山機場及雲南寧蒗瀘沽湖機場的客運航班量和旅客吞吐量均為零。湖北神農架紅坪機場同期僅執行58班航班，運送旅客2594人次，平均每天不到9人；四川九寨黃龍機場同期旅客吞吐量也不足2萬人次。
儘管定期客運航班客流極低甚至為零，機場仍獲巨額補貼，並藉此維持運營。
其中，2026年前10個月，重慶仙女山機場沒有執行一班定期客運航班，也沒有產生客運旅客吞吐量。這座2020年建成通航的機場，主要為重慶武隆仙女山等旅遊景區服務。而根據民航局公布的中小機場補貼預算方案，仙女山機場2026年擬獲得858萬元（人民幣，下同）的補貼，2027年仍擬獲得636萬元的補貼。
類似的情況也出現在雲南寧蒗瀘沽湖機場。根據民航西南地區管理局公布的機場生產情況，2025年7月至12月，瀘沽湖機場連續6個月停航。航班管家DAST的數據顯示，2026年1月至10月，該機場仍沒有執行客運航班，旅客吞吐量為零。但瀘沽湖機場2026年擬獲得987萬元的中央財政補貼，2027年仍有807萬元補貼預算。
湖北神農架紅坪機場雖然仍有航班運行，但今年前10個月僅運送2594名旅客，平均每天不足9人。不過，根據民航局公布的預算方案，神農架紅坪機場2026年擬獲得588萬元補貼，2027年仍擬獲得580萬元。
四川九寨黃龍機場2003年建成通航，2012年旅客吞吐量曾達175.29萬人次，但2025年已降至約3.2萬人次，比高峰時期減少約98%。2026年1月至10月，九寨黃龍機場累計執行航班304班，同比下降41.5%；旅客吞吐量僅19,934人次，同比下降35.8%。
今年10月底，九寨黃龍機場一度因冬春航季航班調整而暫時沒有定期客運航班。隨後，機場方面宣布自11月7日起恢復成都天府往返九寨黃龍航線，由四川航空每週執飛一班。
不過，九寨黃龍機場卻是近年來獲得中央財政中小機場補貼最多的機場之一。2017年，該機場獲得的補貼為1562萬元；2020年降至676萬元。而根據民航局公布的2026年預算方案，其補貼金額達到1.0369億元，2027年仍擬獲得9433萬元，位居全國中小機場首位。
根據民航局發布的《2025年全國民用運輸機場生產統計公報》，截至2025年底，全國共有270座頒證運輸機場，其中年旅客吞吐量不足200萬人次的機場191座，占全國機場總數的71%。但這191座機場合計承擔的旅客吞吐量僅占全國的6%。
而公開預算數據顯示，2017年，中國全國163座中小機場獲得補貼14.29億元；2020年，171座機場獲得補貼15.60億元；2023年，180座機場獲得補貼近18億元。2025年，188座機場擬獲得補貼24.05億元；2026年，補貼機場增加至191座，預算總額達到25.84億元。
事實上，中國更早在2008年便推出中小機場及支線航空補貼政策。業界一般認為，中小機場虧損是因為高鐵和高速公路快速建設，使部分中小機場原有的交通優勢逐漸減弱，客源被分流。安邦智庫宏觀經濟研究中心博士楊希特對「第一財經」表示，一些地方機場建設超前於實際需求，是造成當前部分中小機場經營困難的重要原因。
不過，中國問題專家李林一認為，中國大量地方中小機場的盲目建設與長期虧損，是中共體制結構性弊端的必然產物。地方一把手的升遷完全取決於上級，動輒數十億的機場項目，在立項前既沒有公開透明的成本效益聽證，也沒有媒體有效監督。項目即便建成後成為「鬼城機場」或連年巨虧，決策者往往早已高升。
李林一說，這些大型基建項目往往涉及腐敗和利益輸送。同時，許多地方政府修建機場的真實目的並非航空運輸，而是以「空港經濟區」的名義低價徵收集體土地，推高周邊地價以維繫土地財政，並通過地方政府融資平台向國有銀行套取巨額貸款，最終只會加劇中國系統性的地方債務危機。

title: 台法深化合作 賴清德：共築國際海纜安全命脈
summary: 2026年11月20日，中華民國總統賴清德（右）接見法國國民議會副議長蒲韻珼（Marie-Agnès Poussier-Winsback）（左）率國民議會議員暨法國電信監管機關代表聯合訪團，賴清德總統致詞說明兩國的合作與交流，並就台海安全、經貿、戰略夥伴關係等領域交換意見。（中央社） 【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）中華民國總統賴清德今天（20日）接見法國國民議會副議長蒲韻珼率領的訪問團時表示，近年從歐洲到台海，海底電纜屢遭蓄意破壞，期盼台法深化海
content:
2026年11月20日，中華民國總統賴清德（右）接見法國國民議會副議長蒲韻珼（Marie-Agnès Poussier-Winsback）（左）率國民議會議員暨法國電信監管機關代表聯合訪團，賴清德總統致詞說明兩國的合作與交流，並就台海安全、經貿、戰略夥伴關係等領域交換意見。（中央社）
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）中華民國總統賴清德今天（20日）接見法國國民議會副議長蒲韻珼率領的訪問團時表示，近年從歐洲到台海，海底電纜屢遭蓄意破壞，期盼台法深化海底電纜防護與風險管理合作，聯手打造更具韌性的國際海纜安全命脈。
今天上午，賴清德總統接見「法國國民議會副議長蒲韻珼（Marie-Agnès Poussier-Winsback）率國民議會議員暨法國電信監管機關代表聯合訪團」，首先歡迎在座的法國友人來到台灣。今年5月，他曾跟法國國民議會友台小組主席訪團交流許多意見，很高興今天在總統府迎接蒲韻珼副議長率團來訪。此次國會議員與電信監管機關代表共同前來，不僅展現台法的深厚情誼，相信也將為雙方合作拓展新的契機。
賴清德表示，他衷心感謝訪賓長期為台灣發聲。今年4月，因為中共施壓第三國取消專機的飛航許可，他一度暫緩訪問友邦史瓦帝尼（大陸稱斯威士蘭）。他特別感謝馬堤諾（Éric Martineau）副主席、游蘇法（Estelle Youssouffa）書記以及國會友人的聲援，支持台灣與世界自由來往。
他強調，台灣有權利參與國際事務，也有能力為世界做出貢獻。感謝法國國會及政府以各項行動展現對台灣的支持，包括這個月在巴黎舉行的七大工業國集團（G7）外長會議，重申反對以武力或脅迫片面改變現狀，支持台灣有意義參與國際組織。台灣會持續強化自我防衛能力與全社會防衛韌性，與民主夥伴共同守護印太的和平穩定。
賴清德表示，守護和平也包括確保關鍵基礎設施安全。近年從歐洲到台海，海底電纜屢遭蓄意破壞；為此，台灣提出「國際海底電纜風險管理倡議」，獲得許多歐洲國家國會議員的連署響應，共同守護通訊與能源傳輸的命脈。期盼在訪賓的支持之下，促成台法深化海底電纜防護與風險管理合作，聯手打造更具韌性的國際海纜安全命脈。
法國是台灣在歐盟的第三大貿易夥伴，賴清德說，「從半導體、電動車、再生能源到太空科技，雙方的合作持續深化。期盼未來透過制度化的合作，促進雙向投資與研發，共同打造更安全、穩固的民主供應鏈。台灣希望與法國在科技及民主經驗上，建構更緊密的夥伴關係，讓我們持續以行動守護彼此珍視的自由、民主與人權價值，為兩國開創更繁榮的未來。」
蒲韻珼副議長致詞時，首先感謝賴總統在繁忙行程中撥冗接見及熱情歡迎，此次訪團成員有些是首次來台，有些則是再次造訪，此次參訪感受到台灣的熱情接待及文化、韌性、經濟及各領域的進步與發展。同時訪團也與多位台灣政府官員進行深入且友好的交流，充分展現雙方友好關係；返回法國後，也將繼續推動深化台法友誼。
蒲韻珼表示，法國致力於維護台海和平，未來也將持續堅持此一立場，並透過明確且定期發表聲明，重申反對任何片面改變現狀以及使用武力、威脅使用武力或採取脅迫手段。相關立場不僅在法國國內表達，也透過歐洲及多邊架構，包括近期七大工業國集團（G7）外長會議發表的聲明，持續重申法國立場。此外，台法雙方透過官方及國會交流，在打擊資訊操弄、強化經濟韌性等共同關切領域推動具體合作。
「法國希望進一步深化與台灣的經貿關係。」蒲韻珼指出，法國是歐盟的經濟引擎，也是進入歐盟市場的重要門戶。近年法國對台投資持續成長，也期待吸引更多台灣企業赴法投資，進一步拓展歐洲市場。
蒲韻珼提到，法國非常重視台灣的民主，並希望在此基礎上，深化雙方在文化、教育及科學領域的合作。此外，配合賴清德總統推動的「青年百億海外圓夢基金計劃」，法國也接待多個台灣青年團體赴法交流，安排太空政策、足球、身心障礙者運動及科技等領域的參訪活動，並樂見雙方城市交流持續拓展至台北以外的地區，促進文化、藝術及教育合作。
最後，蒲韻珼表示，近期法國馬約特（Mayotte）訪團來台訪問，讓雙方有機會進一步研擬台灣與馬約特的合作方向。此外，法國具有優異的科研實力，與台灣的產業能力高度互補，鼓勵台灣企業及投資人探索法國新創產業的投資機會，進一步深化雙方科技合作，並再次代表訪團感謝賴清德總統撥冗接見。
外交部表示，訪賓還包括法國國民議會友台小組副主席馬堤諾、電子通信、郵政暨新聞發行監管局執行長何蒂燁（Laure de La Raudière）、國民議會外交委員會書記游蘇法、議員帕蒙勒珂（Charlotte Parmentier-Lecocq）、貝哈達（Belkhir Belhaddad）、費歐蘭（Anne-Cécile Violland）等，由外交部次長吳志中及法國在台協會主任龐維德（Frédéric Laplanche）等人陪同接見。

title: 吳志中：台灣憑藉自身實力可抵禦中共威脅
summary: 中華民國外交部政務次長吳志中接受無國界記者組織（RSF）主席Pierre Haski 專訪，說明中共對台複合式施壓，以及台灣捍衛國家主權與民主制度的堅定立場。（中華民國外交部提供） 【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）面對中共威脅，中華民國外交部次長吳志中近日接受無國界記者組織（RSF）專訪指出，兩岸語言相通，中共的資訊操弄及混合戰確實帶來一定程度影響，但台灣憑藉蓬勃發展的民主制度、經濟實力及社會韌性，持續抵禦威權威脅，證明民主自由與經濟發展可以並存。
content:
中華民國外交部政務次長吳志中接受無國界記者組織（RSF）主席Pierre Haski 專訪，說明中共對台複合式施壓，以及台灣捍衛國家主權與民主制度的堅定立場。（中華民國外交部提供）
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）面對中共威脅，中華民國外交部次長吳志中近日接受無國界記者組織（RSF）專訪指出，兩岸語言相通，中共的資訊操弄及混合戰確實帶來一定程度影響，但台灣憑藉蓬勃發展的民主制度、經濟實力及社會韌性，持續抵禦威權威脅，證明民主自由與經濟發展可以並存。
中華民國外交部今天（20日）發布新聞稿指出，吳志中日前接受RSF專訪，內容於18日露出。
針對中共對台野心，吳志中指出，中共黨魁習近平企圖重塑二戰後的國際秩序，並取代美國成為世界領導者，其領土擴張企圖不僅針對台灣，也涉及周邊海域及國家，也由於武力侵台將對全球經濟及現代生活造成災難性衝擊，因此北京傾向透過外交孤立及各種施壓手段，企圖迫使台灣自行屈服。
面對中共威脅，吳志中強調，台灣展現高度韌性，經濟持續成長，人均GDP已超越日本及韓國，台灣也規劃在國防預算獲得通過後，投入約300億美元強化防衛能力，且在經貿及科技方面，台灣已是美國第四大、日本第三大貿易夥伴，並在全球半導體及人工智慧供應鏈中占有關鍵地位。
吳志中表示，台灣已從「台灣製造」（Made in Taiwan）邁向「與台灣共同製造」（Made with Taiwan），與全球經濟及供應鏈的連結日益緊密。
吳志中指出，台灣每天承受約300萬次網絡攻擊，且因兩岸語言相通，中共的資訊操弄及混合戰確實帶來一定程度影響，但台灣憑藉蓬勃發展的民主制度、經濟實力及社會韌性，持續抵禦威權威脅，不僅證明民主自由與經濟發展可以並存，也為華語世界提供不同的發展典範，展現自由民主的普世價值。
談到台法雙邊關係，吳志中說，台法關係相較10年前已更加緊密，雙邊合作也日益深化，目前台北設有法國文化協會及兩所法國學校，加上台灣重要科技企業宣布赴法投資，顯示台法在各領域的合作持續發展。
對於法國部分政治人物有關「台灣屬於中（共）國」的言論，吳志中指出，歷史事實可說明台灣從未受中華人民共和國管轄，且（中華民國）台灣已是主權獨立國家，無須另行宣布獨立，呼籲國際社會切勿接受北京論述，避免重蹈香港的覆轍。
外交部指出，無國界記者組織（RSF）為致力維護全球新聞自由的重要國際組織。本次專訪於Haski主席個人YouTube頻道「Le Monde de Pierre Haski」播出，向法語觀眾說明台灣面臨的安全挑戰、在全球經濟與科技供應鏈中的重要地位，以及捍衛民主自由的堅定立場。

title: 新華社稱川普「不支持台獨」邱垂正：查證並非事實

content:
陸委會主委邱垂正11月20日前往政大國關中心出席第6屆「理解中國統戰」工作坊會議，他於會前接受媒體聯訪。（中央社）
標籤: 陸委會, 川普, 邱垂正, 台獨, 台灣大紀元
【大紀元2026年11月20日訊】（大紀元記者戴德蔓台灣台北報導）美國總統川普與中共黨魁習近平11月19日在深圳會晤，中共官媒新華社報導稱，川普表態美國「不支持台獨」，對此，陸委會主委邱垂正20日表示，經向外交部門初步查證，相關報導「不是事實」，批評中共官媒慣於在重要會議後替其他國家敘事，並強調政府與美方保持密切溝通，川普究竟說了什麼，應由美方說明。
川普與習近平19日在深圳舉行今年第3次雙邊會晤。根據新華社報導，習近平在會談中表示，「在台灣問題上，美方要堅持做正確的事，避免中美關係出現大的波折」；川普則被引述稱，美國「不支持台獨」。
對於新華社的說法，邱垂正20日上午前往政治大學國際關係研究中心，出席第6屆「理解中國統戰」工作坊表示，政府已進行初步查證，「相關的報導不是事實」，目前也與美方保持密切溝通，至於會談實際內容，應由美方充分說明。
邱垂正指出，中共官媒向來是中共對外宣傳工具，尤其在重要會議之後，經常替其他國家敘事，類似的惡意操作過去不勝枚舉。不管中共如何操作，都無法改變中華民國是主權國家的事實。
「台灣從來不是中華人民共和國的一部分，中華民國與中華人民共和國互不隸屬，這是客觀的事實。」邱垂正表示，這些事實不會因為中共官媒的操作而有所改變。
媒體進一步追問，所謂「不是事實」，是否明確指川普並未說出「美國不支持台獨」？由於有分析認為，「不支持台獨」原本就是美方對台灣的一貫立場。對此，邱垂正重申，這是中共官媒替美方敘事，事實是否如此，應由美方充分說明。他並補充，相關判斷是政府向外交部門查證的結果。
至於川習會是否觸及台灣議題，以及美中互動可能對台海情勢帶來的影響，邱垂正表示，政府的兩岸政策一貫而堅定，就是「不卑不亢、維持現狀」，並致力與友盟國家通力合作，維護台海及區域和平穩定。
他指出，當前透過軍事霸權及脅迫手段，製造區域不安的，是中共政權與俄羅斯，這是眾所皆知的事實。台灣將持續與友盟國家合作，共同維護台海與區域的和平穩定及繁榮。
對於外界關注川普與習近平預料12月還將再次會面，是否可能影響美國對台軍售，邱垂正表示，政府各部會都非常嚴密地關注國際情勢發展，也會積極因應，確保國家安全與國家利益。

|巴布亚新几内亚与西方达成协议后，马拉佩向北京保证
巴布亚新几内亚与西方达成协议后，马拉佩向北京保证
巴布亚新几内亚总理詹姆斯·马拉佩上周在亚太经合组织峰会前夕在深圳与习近平通话，他告诉中国国家主席，关闭台湾驻莫尔兹比港代表处的决定在政治上是困难的，并表示“希望这有助于你们争取统一的努力”。
马拉佩的言论之所以引人注目有两个原因。首先，马拉佩似乎比前任巴布亚新几内亚总理走得更远，明确支持统一。其次，他的声明可能反映出巴布亚新几内亚最近与澳大利亚和美国达成安全协议后安抚北京的努力。
更广泛地说，这一事件说明了巴布亚新几内亚在维持独立外交政策、同时与竞争大国打交道方面面临的困难。
巴布亚新几内亚于 1976 年承认北京，除了 1999 年短暂转向台湾之外，但承认北京政府与明确支持统一不同。历届巴布亚新几内亚政府普遍避免就如何解决争端采取直接立场。马拉佩可能是第一位以如此直接的措辞公开支持统一的巴布亚新几内亚总理。
对于堪培拉和华盛顿来说，教训是安全协议并不能保证更广泛的外交政策协调。
一种可能的解释是巴布亚新几内亚与中国日益增长的经济关系，包括基础设施融资、市场准入、投资和发展援助。在这次会议上，马拉佩敦促中国企业投资下游加工（在新窗口中打开）。
但关闭台湾办事处也会带来经济成本。台湾宣布将停止购买巴布亚新几内亚的液化天然气（LNG）。去年，台湾进口了 180 万吨（在新窗口中打开）巴布亚新几内亚液化天然气，价值约 8 亿美元（在新窗口中打开）。
对于北京来说，台湾是一个核心政治问题，马拉佩的声明具有相当大的外交分量。习近平认可巴布亚新几内亚的立场，赞扬马拉佩“坚定坚持‘一个中国’原则”。
马拉佩承认关闭台湾办事处在政治上很困难，这一点同样有趣。他告诉习近平：“我面临来自内部的挑战，因为我们也与许多国家有联系，但我们下定了决心。”公众舆论可能不是主要障碍：外交政策很少在巴布亚新几内亚国内辩论中占据重要地位，这些辩论主要围绕就业、通货膨胀、公共服务以及法律和秩序，而中国和台湾仍然是少数城市、政治和学术精英的领地。

|Marape reassures Beijing after PNG’s pacts with the West
Marape reassures Beijing after PNG’s pacts with the West
PNG Prime Minister James Marape spoke to (Opens in new window) Xi Jinping in Shenzhen ahead of the APEC Summit last week, telling China’s President that the decision to close Taiwan’s representative office in Port Moresby had been politically difficult and expressed “hope ​this assists you in your efforts for reunification”.
Marape’s remarks stand out for two reasons. First, Marape appears to have gone further than previous PNG prime ministers by explicitly supporting reunification. Second, his statement may reflect an effort to reassure Beijing following PNG’s recent security agreements with Australia and the United States.
More broadly, the episode illustrates the difficulties PNG faces in maintaining an independent foreign policy while engaging with competing powers.
PNG recognised Beijing in 1976, apart from a brief switch to Taiwan in 1999 – but recognising Beijing’s government is different from explicitly backing reunification. Successive PNG governments have generally avoided taking direct positions on how the dispute should be resolved. Marape may be the first PNG prime minister to publicly endorse reunification in such direct terms.
For Canberra and Washington, the lesson is that security agreements do not guarantee broader foreign policy alignment.
One possible explanation is PNG’s growing economic relationship with China (Opens in new window), including infrastructure financing, market access, investment and development assistance. In this meeting, Marape urged Chinese companies to invest in downstream processing (Opens in new window).
But closing Taiwan’s office also carries economic costs. Taiwan announced that it would stop purchasing PNG’s liquefied natural gas (LNG). Last year, Taiwan had imported 1.8 million tonnes (Opens in new window) of PNG LNG worth about (Opens in new window) $800 million.
For Beijing, Taiwan is a core political issue, giving Marape’s statement considerable diplomatic weight. Xi acknowledged PNG’s position, praising Marape for having “firmly adhered to the ‘one China’ principle”.
Marape’s admission that closing Taiwan’s office was politically difficult was equally interesting. He told Xi: “I faced challenges from within, because we also relate to many nations, but we were resolved.” Public opinion was probably not the main obstacle: foreign policy rarely features (Opens in new window) in PNG’s domestic debates, which are dominated by employment, inflation, public services and law and order, while China and Taiwan remain the preserve of a small urban, political and academic elite.
Marape may instead have been referring to resistance within government, the bureaucracy or PNG’s security establishment – or indirectly acknowledging concerns from the United States. The US State Department described Taiwan’s office closure as “yet another example of Beijing’s intimidation campaign against Taiwan”. Although there is no direct evidence Canberra opposed the move, Marape would have been aware of its concerns. His reference to PNG’s relationships with “many nations” may have been deliberately ambiguous, allowing him to demonstrate political commitment to Beijing without identifying those who may have opposed the decision.
Reassuring Beijing after PNG’s security agreements
Marape’s remarks may also be read against PNG’s expanding security ties (Opens in new window) with Australia and the United States – the 2023 Defence Cooperation Agreement with Washington and the 2025 Pukpuk Treaty with Canberra – which may have left Beijing fearing PNG was drifting into the Western security architecture.
Marape’s explicit support for reunification challenges that perception, reassuring Beijing that PNG remains committed to the bilateral relationship despite its growing security cooperation with Western partners, and that defence agreements do not determine its diplomatic positions on other issues. Marape reinforced this message by invoking sovereignty:
“China respects the sovereignty of Papua New Guinea. We must give full respect for the sovereignty of China.”
Although directed at Beijing, he may have had a secondary audience. If Australia and the United States assume PNG is already firmly within their sphere of influence, they may have less incentive to compete for its cooperation. Maintaining constructive relations with Beijing gives PNG additional diplomatic and economic options.
The Butuka Academy in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea, funded by China and opened in November 2018 to accommodate students in its kindergarten, primary school and secondary school (Zhang Jianhua/Xinhua via Getty Images)
China remains an economic partner PNG cannot easily abandon – and neither Australia’s development aid (Opens in new window) nor the United States’ expanded security role gives either country real leverage to change that.
China provides infrastructure financing, investment, construction services and access to markets. In fact, Chinese state-owned enterprises dominate (Opens in new window) the infrastructure sector, implementing projects financed by multilateral institutions, including the Asian Development Bank. Chinese economic involvement consequently extends beyond projects directly financed by Beijing.
Roads, bridges and other visible projects are especially important in PNG politics, to allow politicians to demonstrate that they are delivering to their constituencies. The Connect PNG (Opens in new window)road program is illustrative of the relationship between infrastructure development and political popularity. This road network is intended to connect 13 economic corridors and provinces not previously linked by roads. Marape this year led a convoy of 100 vehicles (Opens in new window) over 830 kilometres from Port Moresby to Morobe Province – on what is now named Pangu Highway, after his own party, and built largely by Chinese contractors.
Chinese financing may also appeal to PNG leaders because it is often perceived as involving fewer political and governance conditions than traditional Western assistance, although loans still carry repayment obligations and financial risks. For leaders facing enormous development challenges and limited fiscal resources, these opportunities are difficult to ignore.
PNG’s longstanding foreign policy of “friends to all, enemies to none (Opens in new window)” provides the flexibility to maintain relationships with competing powers. Although Marape has introduced different versions of this approach, his recent actions suggest that the underlying principle remains. For Canberra and Washington, the lesson is that security agreements do not guarantee broader foreign policy alignment. For PNG, the challenge is whether it can continue balancing these relationships as strategic competition intensifies.
Michael Kabuni is a lecturer in political science at the School of Humanities and Social Sciences, University of Papua New Guinea.

一公斤氧化钇 (Y2O3) 在中国的价格约为 9 美元，但在欧洲约为 1,150 美元，是后者的 125 倍多。在北京收紧稀土出口管制之前（在新窗口中打开），价格差距不大。现在，日本首当其冲受到供应紧张的影响。钇用于电子和激光等高科技制造以及癌症治疗。
东京将价格差异描述为一个全球性问题。日本经济产业省（METI）官员表示，中国的钇出口已陷入停滞，导致全球价格走高。
但贸易数据讲述了一个更尖锐的故事。据报道，2026 年前 9 个月，中国对日本的氧化钇出口量骤降 98%（在新窗口中打开），从 887 吨降至仅 18 吨。中国的全球出口仅下降了26%，而对日本以外目的地的出口量却增加了一倍多。这种差异表明有选择性的供应限制。
日本制造商正在争先恐后地寻找替代供应。东京（在新窗口中打开）还就钇短缺问题向华盛顿和其他盟友寻求帮助。
时机很重要。中国于 2025 年 4 月对包括钇在内的几种中重稀土实行出口许可。但在日本首相高市早苗于 2025 年 11 月暗示中国对台湾的军事封锁可能构成威胁生存的局势 — — 在某些条件下允许集体自卫的法律门槛后，紧张局势升级。
北京方面认为这些言论跨越了红线。据报道，在中国于 2026 年 1 月限制向日本军事用户和军事相关最终用途的军民两用出口 (在新窗口中打开) 之前，对日本的钇出货量较 12 月有所减少。2 月，北京禁止向 20 个日本实体 (在新窗口中打开) 出口，并对另外 20 个实体进行了严格审查。
一种鲜为人知的稀土已成为不太可能的地缘政治杠杆来源。
小要素，大杠杆
尽管钇的原子量相对较轻，但在商业上与重稀土归为一类。与用于高性能永磁体的钕和镝不同，钇的价值在于先进陶瓷和特种涂层。钇稳定氧化锆可保护喷气发动机部件免受极端高温的影响，而钇基化合物可保护半导体设备免受腐蚀性等离子体的影响。它还用于激光器、光学材料和医疗器械。

The yttrium squeeze: How a little-known rare earth became China’s latest geopolitical lever
A kilogram of yttrium oxide (Y2O3) costs around US$9 in China but roughly US$1,150 in Europe – more than 125 times as much. Before Beijing tightened rare earth export controls (Opens in new window), the price gap was modest. Now, Japan is bearing the brunt of the supply squeeze. Yttrium is used in high-tech manufacturing across electronics and lasers as well as cancer treatments.
Tokyo has portrayed the price disparity as a global problem. Officials at Japan’s Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) have said China’s yttrium exports have stalled, driving global prices higher.
But the trade figures tell a more pointed story. In the first nine months of 2026, China’s yttrium oxide exports to Japan reportedly plunged 98% (Opens in new window), from 887 tonnes to just 18 tonnes. China’s global exports fell by only 26%, while shipments to destinations other than Japan more than doubled. The disparity suggests selective supply restrictions.
Japanese manufacturers are scrambling for alternative supplies. Tokyo (Opens in new window) has also sought help from Washington and other allies over yttrium shortages.
The timing matters. China introduced export licensing for several medium and heavy rare earths, including yttrium, in April 2025. But tensions escalated after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi suggested in November 2025 that a Chinese blockade of Taiwan involving military force could constitute a survival-threatening situation – a legal threshold permitting collective self-defence under certain conditions.
Beijing regarded the remarks as crossing a red line. Yttrium shipments to Japan reportedly dwindled from December, before China restricted dual-use exports (Opens in new window) to Japanese military users and military-related end uses in January 2026. In February, Beijing prohibited exports to 20 Japanese entities (Opens in new window) and placed another 20 under heightened scrutiny.
A little-known rare earth has become an unlikely source of geopolitical leverage.
Small element, large leverage
Although relatively light in atomic weight, yttrium is commercially grouped with the heavy rare earths. Unlike neodymium and dysprosium, used in high-performance permanent magnets, yttrium’s value lies in advanced ceramics and specialised coatings. Yttrium-stabilised zirconia protects jet-engine components from extreme heat, while yttrium-based compounds shield semiconductor equipment from corrosive plasma. It is also used in lasers, optical materials and medical devices.
Manufacturers need relatively small quantities, but shortages can disrupt production of equipment worth millions of dollars. Qualifying alternative materials for aerospace and semiconductor applications can take years.
Japan's Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi at the APEC summit: China escalated tensions last year following her comments about Taiwan (@takaichi_sanae/X)
Yttrium is generally recovered alongside other rare earths (Opens in new window), rather than mined independently. Deposits exist outside China, including in Australia, but separating and refining them requires specialised expertise and processing capacity. China has spent decades developing these capabilities through integrated supply chains and economies of scale.
Japan excels in advanced materials and precision manufacturing, but remains heavily dependent on China for upstream rare earth processing, which carries consequences in downstream production. China also relies on Japanese manufacturing equipment and specialised materials, but it has developed domestic alternatives in most areas.
This is asymmetric interdependence: both countries depend on each other, but not equally. When geopolitical tensions rise, control over difficult-to-replace inputs becomes a bargaining tool.
From midstream chokepoints to industrial-system power
For Tokyo, the script is familiar. In September 2010, following a collision near the disputed Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands, Japan detained a Chinese fishing boat captain. Chinese rare earth shipments subsequently stalled. Beijing denied imposing an embargo, but an OECD analysis (Opens in new window) later identified disruptions consistent with informal restrictions.
Japan responded by investing in alternative supplies, particularly in Australia, expanding recycling and building stockpiles. Yet the current squeeze exposes diversification’s limits: securing minerals elsewhere does not necessarily eliminate dependence on Chinese processing.
The more Beijing exploits its industrial-system power for immediate leverage, the stronger the incentive for affected countries to reduce their dependence.
China’s dominance in rare earth separation and refining is often described as midstream power (Opens in new window). Even minerals mined elsewhere depend on Chinese processing. Rules introduced by Beijing in 2025 (Opens in new window) brought imported rare earth feedstock processed in China under domestic production quotas.
But China’s advantage extends beyond midstream power. Its 2023 export controls on gallium and germanium (Opens in new window) illustrate broader leverage. Gallium is recovered mainly as a byproduct of processing bauxite into alumina. China accounts for approximately 98% of global primary gallium production (Opens in new window), reflecting its vast basic industries, integrated production networks and economies of scale.
This is industrial-system power: the capacity to influence global production through interconnected processes spanning upstream mining to downstream manufacturing, rather than merely owning mineral deposits or frontier technologies.
Beijing has increasingly institutionalised the exercise of that power. Export licences, end-user restrictions, production quotas and supply-chain traceability provide tools for controlling strategic materials. Like Washington’s export-control regime, these measures can target particular technologies, companies and end uses.
Beijing’s export controls impose economic costs on Japan’s semiconductor, automotive and aerospace industries. The effects, however, extend beyond Japan: its manufacturers supply critical components and materials to American industrial and defence uses.
Discouraging Japanese military involvement in a Taiwan conflict is a strategic priority for Beijing. Yet direct confrontation with Japan carries serious escalation risks, given the US–Japan security alliance (Opens in new window). Critical mineral controls offer pressure below the threshold of armed conflict.
By constraining Japanese manufacturers’ access to upstream materials, Beijing can potentially disrupt allied supply chains.
Export controls also offer flexibility for Beijing. It can adjust licensing approvals, scrutinise end users or restrict companies, increasing or easing pressure without military force. Whether this can persuade Tokyo to moderate its Taiwan stance remains uncertain.
But weaponising supply chains can be a double-edged sword. The more Beijing exploits its industrial-system power for immediate leverage, the stronger the incentive for affected countries to reduce their dependence. The squeeze reinforces Japan’s diversification efforts and deepens economic-security cooperation with Washington and other allies – potentially weakening China’s leverage in the long term.
For resource-rich middle powers such as Australia, the yttrium squeeze exposes a new dimension of great-power competition. The US–China technology rivalry extends beyond advanced semiconductors and frontier AI to the industrial inputs on which these technologies depend.
Australia has the resources, but resources alone do not confer industrial power. Canberra’s Critical Minerals Strategy (Opens in new window) recognises the need to move beyond mining towards processing and refining. Its expanded partnership with Japan (Opens in new window) offers an opportunity to combine Australian resources and expertise with Japanese capital, technology and industrial demand.
The lesson from yttrium is clear: strategic autonomy depends less on what lies beneath the ground than on what a country can do with it. The challenge for Canberra is to turn these ambitions into commercially viable capabilities.
Dr Marina Yue Zhang is an associate professor at the Australia-China Relations Institute, University of Technology Sydney (UTS: ACRI).

Trump concluded a two-day visit to the Philippines for a State Visit and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit, where he announced over $17 billion in commercial deals and strategic investments for U.S. companies that will support tens of thousands of American jobs, bolster regional security that protects the United States from illicit activity, and support a free and open Indo-Pacific that economically benefits American companies, workers, and consumers. SECURING HISTORIC DEALS WITH THE PHILIPPINES: President Ferdinand R. Marcos, Jr. hosted President Trump for a historic State Visit in Manila, where the two leaders announced landmark deals that will strengthen the U.S.-Philippine Alliance and support American companies and workers. The leaders also committed to eliminate the U.S. trade deficit with the Philippines through increased Philippine imports of American energy and agriculture products, which will support the jobs of tens of thousands of American engineers, technicians, and farmers. U.S. companies Boeing and GE Aerospace finalized a $12 billion sale to Philippine Airlines for up to 20 Boeing 787 aircrafts with GE Aerospace engines, supporting 47,000 U.S. jobs. The United States and the Philippines will pursue a historic Foreign Military Financing (FMF) loan package of more than $2 billion to provide the Philippines with critical defense and security capabilities from U.S. suppliers, supporting over 7,000 American jobs and advancing the President’s National Security Strategy and America First Arms Transfer Strategy, all while protecting returns for the American taxpayer. President Trump’s America First Arms Transfer Strategy ensures that the surge in allies’ spending benefits the U.S. defense industry, reindustrializing America and supporting American jobs while arming our partners with the best capabilities in the world. The United States will utilize $400 million in FMF for the Philippine military to expand its operational reach and deterrence capabilities in the South China Sea, including long-range fires, command and control, critical infrastructure, and multi-domain drones, supporting 1,500 American jobs. The United States and the Philippines agreed to partner on supply the Philippines’ sovereign cloud infrastructure with trusted U.S. Super Intelligence technology through the United States’ SI Exports Program. The Philippine Department of National Defense (DND) announced a $37 million contract with a U.S. firm, supporting 140 American jobs. The contract delivers SI-enabled mission support, expands U.S.-Philippine defense cooperation, and improves interoperability. The Philippine DND committed to work with trusted U.S. technology providers on a $63 million initiative to modernize its defense cloud infrastructure for SI use cases, supporting over 200 American jobs. The United States and the Philippines committed to improving cooperation in critical technologies. The United States and the Philippines announced exploration of an intergovernmental agreement on civil-nuclear technology which would open opportunities for U.S. nuclear companies, support American jobs, and generate gigawatts of energy for the Philippines. This marks the first U.S. civil-nuclear intergovernmental agreement with an Indo-Pacific partner. U.S. company Astranis announced it is offering connectivity services from its U.S.-manufactured AGILA satellite to the Philippines, a commercial opportunity worth up to $200 million, supporting 600 American jobs, to provide independent and secure communications infrastructure for the Philippine government and people. President Trump is leveraging strategic infrastructure to strengthen the U.S.-Philippine Alliance, secure critical supply chains, open new markets for American businesses, and support American workers. Subic Grain will build a new $40 million fuel storage depot at Subic Bay to support U.S. military and commercial operations. The United States and the Philippines announced that the Philippines will modernize its Basco Airport to improve U.S.-Philippine operational access, disaster response, and commercial supply chains in the Philippines’ northernmost islands. FINALIZING THE U.S.-THAILAND TRADE DEAL AND INCREASING MILITARY SALES:   At the ASEAN Summit, President Trump announced the substantial conclusion of a trade deal and a weapons sale with Thailand that will give American workers, manufacturers, farmers, ranchers, and businesses unprecedented access to Thailand’s market.   The trade deal, once signed, will eliminate tariffs on 99 percent of goods and remove non-tariff barriers on American vehicles, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, ethanol, and poultry, increasing market access for a full range of U.S. industrial and agricultural exports. The trade deal will also protect and enforce U.S. intellectual property, increase economic security alignment, and strengthen and enforce Thai labor and environmental laws to balance trade. Separately, Thailand intends to commit up to $123 million toward the purchase of America’s High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS). The sale would give America’s treaty Ally long-range precision fires and support 400 American jobs and the U.S. defense industrial base. Once concluded, it would be the first deal of its kind in mainland Southeast Asia. SECURING INVESTMENT DEALS ACROSS SOUTHEAST ASIA:   President Trump opened new markets for American goods and created opportunities for U.S. companies, furthering U.S. leadership in digital connectivity across the region. In Indonesia, U.S. company Latitude Energy and Indonesian sovereign wealth fund Danantara announced negotiations on a $2 billion project that will use world-class U.S. technology to improve Indonesia’s utilization of its coal resources. Panasonic signed a multi-year agreement to buy advanced silicon-carbon anode materials from U.S. company Sila. The agreement is worth up to $1 billion and will support an additional 500 American jobs. In Malaysia, Navajo Transitional Energy Company (NTEC) signed a three-year $100 million agreement to supply coal from its southern Montana mine to TNB Fuel Services, the fuel procurement subsidiary of Malaysia’s national power utility, Tenaga Nasional Berhad. LEADING THE REGION IN SUPER INTELLIGENCE: In addition to Philippine commitments on American SI technology above, President Trump announced further deployment of American SI technology across the region through our SI Exports Program, cementing U.S. firms and American technology as the global standard for trusted partners. President Trump and Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar announced that a U.S. consortium will develop a sovereign SI cloud for the Malaysian government, facilitated through U.S.-ASEAN SI SPARK. Brunei’s Unified National Networks intends to award U.S. company Vertiv the Rimba Data Centre tender and source the nearly $1 billion buildout from U.S. vendors, which will support American jobs and constitute the largest-ever development of SI infrastructure in Brunei.
